patch.value: Export --push aborts the whole batch on the first failed item

The exporter create/update loops in registerExporter threw a CommandError inside the loop on the first failed item, so one bad item (invalid issuetype, a required custom field, a 4xx) aborted the entire batch, abandoning all remaining items with no record of what succeeded and risking duplicates on retry. The import path and the sibling pm-linear exporter already isolate per-item failures.

per-item create/update failures are isolated and counted; the batch completes and reports a summary; successful items keep provenance; happy path + dry-run byte-identical; unit test proves continue-on-failure
Fixed: per-item-isolated push runner continues on failure (line 1786); checks if all items failed and throws CommandError (line 1809). Verified in current code.
